reuse.why: All rules (already linked, closed target, replace) go into the existing shared linkBankSyncAccount, Fintegra linking reuses it, Fintegra download reuses a generalised Akahu downloader, and the unlink field-clearing is extracted and shared with unlinkAccount.

duplication.why: No rule is copied; the only near-repetition is the provider wrappers threading replaceExistingLink and the parallel akahu/fintegra dispatch calls in syncAccount.

placement.why: Link preconditions live in the shared link routine before any write, and download logic stays in sync.ts; Fintegra is added to AccountSyncSource as an ad-hoc union member instead of the SYNC_PROVIDERS registry that defines providers.

scope.why: Covers the four requested steps; includes an unrelated import reorder in schedules/app.ts.

maintainability.why: A single link routine owns every linking rule and moving findOrCreateBank inside it keeps refusals side-effect free; the provider list now has two sources of truth for fintegra.

bypasses_abstraction.where: types/models/account.ts adds 'fintegra' as `BankSyncProviders | 'fintegra'` instead of extending SYNC_PROVIDERS in types/models/bank-sync.ts.

disguised_duplication.where: downloadAkahuTransactions is generalised rather than copied, and the unlink clearing is extracted into clearAccountBankLink rather than duplicated.

abstraction_drift.where: linkBankSyncAccount gains replaceExistingLink and takes institution+bankId instead of a prebuilt bank (real variation, used uniformly by all providers); processBankSyncDownload's akahu balance branch is widened with `|| 'fintegra'`; every provider link goes through the shared routine.
